name: token-preview
description: Before you send a long prompt, says how many tokens it is and how much of the context window it will take, then asks. /token shows how full the context is and measures a pasted text without sending it.

threshold.title: Long prompt threshold (tokens)
threshold.description: Prompts estimated above this many tokens ask before sending.

askFirst.title: Ask before sending
askFirst.description: When off, long prompts go out without asking and only a note is added to the chat.
